image.styles: Smooth, polished Pixar 3D in the art style of the movie Coco, soft rounded features and large expressive eyes, simple naturalistic clothing rendered with subtle fabric texture. Realistic human body proportions, expressive sculpted faces.

video.style: 整体视觉风格与角色参考图保持一致。画面以定格动画的质感为基调，动画过渡流畅自然，色调温暖，适合教育类内容的视觉呈现。
